failure_summary.description: Agents repeated base searches instead of retrieving compatible cached results and filtering them with the new constraints.
Attraction requests were normalized to different category values or a state abbreviation was passed as a city.
A return date was passed as an outbound flight arrival date instead of searching a separate reverse-direction leg.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already explicitly requires cache retrieval and filtering, exact entity/category preservation, correct state-versus-city mapping, and separate directional searches for return legs. These failures reflect noncompliance with those instructions, so additional edits would duplicate existing guidance.
